title: Characteristic rank-stratum idempotent on direct-image-algebra module sheaves
statement: Let i: Z → Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], let A = i_*O_Z and g_* be module direct image to A-modules [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category, def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Let r: Z → ℕ be locally constant and U_k its clopen rank strata [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex]. For every q there is a natural endomorphism η of the identity functor on all A-module sheaves such that η² = η and, for every k and every O_{U_k}-module F, η on g_*j_{k,*}F is the identity if k=q and zero otherwise. There is no finiteness assumption on the image of r.

source.place: Tag 00EE; agent-written expansion of steps 1--2 of lem-sc-clopen-rank-strata-homology-lift, as explained in its Lean docstring

proof.text: Choose the unique characteristic idempotent e of U_q using the scheme clopen-idempotent correspondence. On an open V of Y use multiplication by e restricted to i⁻¹(V).
Commutativity makes multiplication module-linear. Restrictions and all module morphisms commute with this multiplication. Idempotence of e gives η²=η. These equalities are checked on every section.

The scalar action on g_*j_{k,*}F is restriction further to U_k∩i⁻¹(V). Section extensionality by germs identifies this restriction with 1 for k=q, and 0 for k≠q. This proves the two asserted morphism equalities, including empty strata.

theorem clopenRankStratum_module_projector
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ η : 𝟭 (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) ⟶
        𝟭 (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))),
      η ≫ η = η ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (F : (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r k).toScheme.Modules),
        η.app ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r k).ι).obj F)) =
        if k = q then 𝟙 _ else 0
